Interface AppointmentManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
AppointmentService
public interface AppointmentManager
The AppointmentManager interface defines the methods required for managing appointments in the hospital management system. It includes functionalities for scheduling, rescheduling, canceling, and viewing appointment statuses.
